name: Notification user worker critical
description: Queue heartbeat, backlog and relay failures; counts only

selectors: SELECT if(COUNT(*) = 0 OR SUM(attributes['heartbeat_count']) < 1 OR SUM(attributes['attention_count']) >= 1, 1, 0) AS value FROM logs.workersLogs WHERE accountTag = 'ACCOUNT_ID' AND scriptName = 'WORKER_NAME' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10' MINUTE AND attributes['event'] = 'x_worker_observation'
